_: CHAR-STRIP (Nov 8 2026, design/godot-avatar.md): the cast. One person = one id here = one baked file. scripts/cast.gd Cast.body(id) is the ONLY way any view makes a person (the player in the world, the menu portrait and its chooser row, attendants with "look": "cast", the talk camera, which frames the attendant's body). Each entry: name (shown in the menu's chooser), sex (m/f: the walk clip), height_m, hips (the skeleton's hips height, for NpcRig), and its file: "glb": res://cast/<id>.glb (CHAR-BUILD's baked person, design/godot-characters-research.md section 3) or, until CHAR-BUILD delivers, "stub": a Mixamo crowd skin (npc/skins/<id>.scn) that stands in for a cast member. A stub is chosen here in data, never by testing at runtime whether a file is there; a missing file means the person is not shown and an error is logged. player: the chooser row in order (3-4). default: who a new player is. Every entry below is a PLACEHOLDER: Steven names and describes the cast.
